habit.description: After blocking two hits in a row the Kappa grabs. Stop at one hit, or jump or back off after the second block, and the throw whiffs.

notes: Anti-air (YOK-165): answers opponent_jumping with the generic throw (C4), the single attacking answer so jump_punish_pct sets the rate; it catches the jumper in landing frames (E19). Swap to a Kappa rising normal when one lands. Kappa aggressive (Y2): walks straight into throw range. Its throw is the generic throw (C4); data/moves has no kappa-* normals or clips yet, so it has no strikes of its own. Add pokes when they land. YOK-234: River Grab at close range, weight 25 beside the generic throw 45 (160-unit command grab, breakable); Shell Spin (projectile-invulnerable) on projectile_on_screen, weight 40, only in the Elder Kappa fight because the rare is in the elder loadout (A9); absent move is skipped. Habit and tell_cover unchanged.
